prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: Italian teaching slide, paired media fedeltà of the existing Passo website.
The supplied website screenshots are structural and content references. Create ONE large landscape 16:9 board, approximately 2048x1152, with exactly TWO equal browser/page panels side by side on plain white, left "dettaglio", right "riepilogo". This is a website, never phone mockups or device photography. No slide title, captions, arrows between panels or decorative framing.
Style: Wireframe digitale ordinato in scala di grigi. Stesse posizioni, dimensioni, contenuti e ordine dei bozzetti di riferimento. Linee rette, campi e pulsanti definiti, tipografia sans serif pulita e grande, gerarchia precisa. Niente colori di marca, fotografie o decorazioni.
Keep the actual Passo information architecture and composition from the references. In each panel, a compact header has the wordmark "passo." and compact navigation: Il servizio, Trova una visita, Assistenza, Le mie visite. On booking pages show the four steps Cerca, Scegli, Controlla, Esito. Adapt spacing and line breaks for teaching legibility, preserving each screen's groups and columns. All UI texts must be Italian, large, dark and highly legible; prioritize the exact labels below. No lorem ipsum or invented buttons, ratings, reviews, payment or account login.
LEFT SCREEN:
{
  "id": "dettaglio",
  "title": "La tua visita a domicilio.",
  "lines": [
    "Giulia Riva",
    "17 novembre 2026 · 20:30",
    "45 minuti",
    "Via Esempio 12, Milano",
    "20121 Milano",
    "60 €",
    "Spostamento incluso",
    "Conferma dopo l’accettazione di Giulia."
  ],
  "primary": "Continua al riepilogo"
}
RIGHT SCREEN:
{
  "id": "riepilogo",
  "title": "Un ultimo sguardo, poi ci incontriamo.",
  "lines": [
    "I tuoi contatti",
    "Nome e cognome",
    "Viola Esempio",
    "Email",
    "viola@example.com",
    "Telefono (facoltativo)",
    "Giulia Riva",
    "17 novembre 2026 · 20:30",
    "Via Esempio 12, Milano",
    "45 minuti · Totale 60 €",
    "Spostamento incluso",
    "Ho letto l’informativa privacy.",
    "L’invio apre una richiesta in attesa."
  ],
  "primary": "Invia richiesta",
  "secondary": "Modifica i dati"
}
Composition details:
Detail: professional identity and explanation at left, visit fact summary with day/time/address/total and continue action at right. Review: contact form at left with name, email, optional phone, and a privacy checkbox; professional/visit summary and Invio action at right. Both columns must remain visible, never reduce review to a fact list. Compress secondary copy so all primary controls are within the panel.
Use grayscale digital wireframes only, clear sans serif text, thin clean rules and restrained gray placeholders for photographic areas. Keep the same composition as the hand version. No brand colors or real photographs.
Data invariants: Via Esempio 12, Milano; CAP 20121; 17 novembre 2026; Giulia Riva at 20:30 or 21:15; Luca Sala at 21:45; 45 minutes; 60 € total including travel. Submission creates a pending request; only professional acceptance confirms.

Exact navigation rule: show the Cerca/Scegli/Controlla/Esito stepper ONLY on ricerca, risultati, dettaglio and riepilogo. Do NOT show a stepper on home, visits, pending or confirmed pages. The patient in the lower home content area is an elderly white-haired bearded MAN with a septum ring, as in the provided patient reference, not the female hero client.
